title: minority inference
observed_actions: Notices reactions inconsistent with apparently cooperative answers; inspects the private question-card incentive.
observed_result: Infers self-interest may explain the group's surprising outcomes.
epistemic_limits: A facial reaction is not proof of individual votes; alternative explanations remain.
information_available: Only own observations and explicitly acquired information; no canonical event history after divergence.
counterfactual_test: Alter incentives, available clues and counterpart behavior. A facial reaction is not proof of individual votes; alternative explanations remain. Allow failure.
